tasks.gr9-entrepreneurship-planning-t2: Topic: Entrepreneurship and financial planning. Cover entrepreneurial traits (innovation, resilience, customer focus), identifying business opportunities, budgeting, financial planning, business viability assessment, and small-business decisions. Ask Grade 9 learners to evaluate business ideas, identify market opportunities, create realistic budgets, forecast cash flow, assess viability factors, and justify entrepreneurial decisions with financial analysis.
tasks.gr9-budgeting-business-decisions-t2: Topic: Budgeting and business decisions. Cover creating realistic budgets, distinguishing fixed and variable costs, monitoring budget variance, prioritizing expenses, responding to variance, and using budgets for strategic decisions (hiring, expansion, equipment). Ask Grade 9 learners to prepare budgets, analyse variance, identify root causes of variances, recommend adjustments, and evaluate impact on business strategy.
tasks.gr9-debtors-credit-t2: Topic: Credit sales and debtors. Cover credit sales and the sales invoice, the National Credit Act (protecting consumers), the debtors journal (DJ), debtors allowances and credit notes (DAJ), receipts from debtors in the cash receipts journal, and the debtors control account. Ask Grade 9 learners to classify transactions into the right journal and calculate what a debtor owes.
